question: Kazakhstan made history at the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics by winning a gold medal in which specific event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Figure Skating.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Historic Achievement:** **Mikhail Shaidorov** made history for Kazakhstan at the **Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics** by winning the gold medal in the Men's Individual **Figure Skating** event.
 
• **First for Kazakhstan:** This was Kazakhstan's **first-ever Olympic gold medal in figure skating**, surpassing the bronze medal feat of the late Denis Ten at the 2014 Sochi Games.
 
• **Major Upset:** Shaidorov’s technical precision and triple-axel combinations led him to victory in a highly competitive field where favorites like USA's Ilia Malinin fell out of the medal positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Performance Highlights__**

__
 
• **Technical Prowess:** Known for his incredible jumping ability, Shaidorov delivered a flawless free skate program that earned him one of the highest scores in the history of the sport for a Kazakh athlete.
 
• **Global Impact:** His win signaled a shift in figure skating dominance, bringing a Central Asian nation to the top of the podium in a traditionally European and North American dominated sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About Figure Skating at 2026__**

 
• While Shaidorov won the men's gold, the **Pairs event** was won by Japan's **Miura and Kihara**, and the **Women's event** was won by USA's **Alysa Liu**.
 
• The Figure Skating events were among the most-watched competitions of the 2026 Games, held at the Mediolanum Forum in Milan.
